parameters.snippet:
ruby
# Check if the file's MIME type matches the expected audio type
require 'mimemagic'

def valid_audio_file?(file_path)
  mime = MimeMagic.by_path(file_path)
  mime && mime.type.start_with?('audio/')
end

file_path = '/var/songs/peters_mixtape.mp3'
puts valid_audio_file?(file_path) # Expected output: true or false based on the file's MIME type

parameters.query: Rails send_file method MIME type handling
parameters.snippet:
ruby
# Check if the MIME type matches the file extension
def mime_type_for_extension(extension)
  case extension
  when '.mp3'
    'audio/mpeg'
  when '.wav'
    'audio/wav'
  when '.flac'
    'audio/flac'
  else
    'application/octet-stream'
  end
end

# Example usage
extension = '.mp3'
assert mime_type_for_extension(extension) == 'audio/mpeg'
